biotools.summary: ClusterONE Web is a freely available, web-based tool for discovering and analyzing overlapping protein complexes from PPI networks. It includes preprocessed PPI datasets and allows users to upload their own data, providing built-in Gene Ontology enrichment analysis for functional interpretation.
